links.comparator_used: Visual-only condition (image with overlaid lesion contour, no conflicting text)
links.outcome: Overall diagnostic accuracy on hemorrhage versus drusen discrimination when the contour was paired with an inconsistent textual claim
links.effect: Overall accuracy dropped from 75% to 46% relative to the visual-only condition
links.tradeoff: The inconsistent textual cue overrode the correct visual cue, a new failure mode of textual dominance
links.quote: When an overlaid lesion contour is paired with an inconsistent textual claim, the textual prompt overrides the correct visual cue: overall accuracy drops from 75% to 46% relative to the visual-only condition, and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning is associated with further degradation rather than self-correction.

links.comparator_used: Prompting without Chain-of-Thought reasoning (inconsistent text and contour condition)
links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy under conflicting text and visual cues
links.effect: CoT was associated with further degradation rather than self-correction; no separate numbers given in the abstract
links.tradeoff: CoT did not correct the model's textual override and was associated with worse performance
links.quote: When an overlaid lesion contour is paired with an inconsistent textual claim, the textual prompt overrides the correct visual cue: overall accuracy drops from 75% to 46% relative to the visual-only condition, and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning is associated with further degradation rather than self-correction.

links.outcome: Direction of predictions (bias toward the prompted finding)
links.effect: One-shot textual prompts biased predictions toward the prompted finding; no numbers reported in the abstract
links.tradeoff: Prediction bias toward the prompted finding
links.quote: (ii) Compared with zero-shot inference, one-shot textual prompts bias predictions toward the prompted finding.

design_hint: prompting strategies (one-shot text, CoT, contour overlay) as safeguards
